_comment: Intentional doc references the staleness scanner (pnpm docs:staleness) should NOT flag. Paths resolve against GIT-TRACKED files (deterministic across machines + CI), so `paths` = tokens with no tracked file/dir on purpose: illustrative example paths, cross-repo (clinozy-be) paths, and gitignored per-developer local files (mcp.json, settings.local.json). `symbols` = identifiers that intentionally do not exist as a src/ export yet (planned APIs, prose examples). Each entry needs a reason; the scanner is advisory (weekly sync-drift canary) so this list absorbs deliberate references, not real drift. Keep it shrinking toward zero.
